notes: the fixed Musnad Zayd shape: زيد بن علي, أبيه, جده, علي

the second part «سألت زيدا عليه السلام عن الرجل يفوته شئ من التكبير» has an unnamed speaker («سألت») and no chain of its own; it is read as the saying of the same report, and whether it adds a route ending at Zayd (named after «سألت») needs a ruling; no link is added here
